Terms of Service

Rules, operational standards, and risk disclosures for the OpenHouse protocol.

1. Nature of the Protocol

OpenHouse is a non-custodial gaming protocol governed by automated Solana smart contracts. The protocol operates transparently where all game logic, randomness seeds, and bankroll allocations are publicly inspectable on-chain.

2. Eligibility & Age Restrictions

You must be at least 18 years of age (or the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction) to participate. By connecting a wallet to OpenHouse, you represent and warrant that your access does not violate local regulations in your geographic region.

3. Provable Fairness & Seed Verification

All game outcomes are derived strictly from cryptographic commitments: a SHA256 pre-committed server seed, a player-controlled client seed, and sequential nonce counters. Results can be verified independently at any time by re-running the HMAC-SHA256 calculations.

4. Non-Custodial Vault & Solvency Rules

Player and investor funds are governed by the Vault PDA. The smart contract enforces an immutable mathematical cap: no individual wager can risk more than 1% of the vault's unreserved balance. In the event of network disruption or server non-responsiveness, player funds can be refunded automatically after a 60-second safety timeout.

5. Risk & Responsible Participation

Participating in casino games involves substantial financial risk. You should only play with funds you can afford to lose. We provide on-chain limits, session time caps, and self-exclusion mechanisms under the Limits menu.

Privacy Policy

How data, cryptographic keys, and analytics are handled on OpenHouse.

1. Non-Custodial Key Architecture

OpenHouse never requests, accesses, or stores your private keys or seed phrases. All transactions and session keys are signed locally by your web3 wallet (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack) and submitted directly to the Solana blockchain.

2. On-Chain Ledger & Public Transparency

Transactions executed on the Solana network are inherently public, permanent, and pseudonymous. Your public wallet address, bet amounts, nonces, and winnings are recorded immutably on the Solana distributed ledger.

3. Local Client Storage

Preferences such as sound effects, active display currency, and ephemeral session limits are stored solely within your device's browser localStorage. No cookies or third-party trackers are utilized for user surveillance.

4. Settlement Communications

When placing wagers, client seeds and nonces are communicated over encrypted HTTPS connections to the settlement node to facilitate instant provably fair outcome resolution.

Legal & Safety

Terms of Service Privacy Policy Responsible Gaming Help & FAQ

1. Core Architecture

OpenHouse operates on a hybrid on-chain / off-chain settlement model designed for sub-second gameplay latency and cryptographically verifiable solvency:

  • On-Chain Vault: Holds 100% of player deposits and liquidity provider capital. No server can withdraw funds unilaterally.
  • Settlement Service: Off-chain daemon that generates SHA256-committed random seeds and executes game math.
  • Solvency Gate: The smart contract strictly enforces max_risk ≤ k × (Vault - Reserved) where k = 1%.
  • Refund Safety: If settlement fails within 60 seconds, any player can trigger an on-chain refund.

3. Provable Fairness Algorithm

Outcomes are generated using HMAC-SHA256 with the server seed as key and client_seed:nonce:round as message:

// Generate random floats from HMAC-SHA256
const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', serverSeed);
hmac.update(`${clientSeed}:${nonce}:${round}`);
const hash = hmac.digest();
const floatVal = hash.readUInt32BE(0) / 4294967296.0;
const diceRoll = Math.floor(floatVal * 10000) / 100.0;

Help & FAQ

What is OpenHouse? +

OpenHouse is a non-custodial casino built on Solana. Games marked Live are verified on chain and paid from a public vault that anyone can inspect; other games are practice-only demos.

How do I start playing? +

Connect a Phantom, Solflare, or Backpack wallet set to Solana Devnet, then head to Games. You can airdrop Devnet SOL from the Cashier page at no cost.

Are the games fair? +

Yes. All outcomes use HMAC-SHA256 with a server seed committed before each session. You can verify every result independently on the Fairness page using your nonce and seeds.

What is the Vault? +

The Vault is an on-chain Program Derived Address (PDA) holding all player and liquidity provider funds. No server can withdraw unilaterally. Deposits and winnings flow directly through smart contracts.

How do I get help or report an issue? +

Open an issue on GitHub. Live support opens with the mainnet launch.
